summary: VPR Brands, LP filed an 8-K reporting a Settlement and Patent License Agreement with R.J. Reynolds Vapor Company. The registrant granted a non-exclusive, worldwide, perpetual license under U.S. Patent No. 8,205,622 B2 for $14,900,000, resolving patent litigation without admission of liability. This is a litigation settlement and IP licensing arrangement, not a special situation. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, spin-off, or other standard special-situation category.
